`docs/tickets/112_R2.6__control-steer-interpreters.md` (seq 112, Round 2).
Base `svitali/harnessharness-r2.5` @ `ee6b27c`; branch

## Scope

- DF-S2.11-1 — durable `queue_next_turn` steer (the pending cue survives
  a restart; the wakeup seam's `delivery_mode = steer` admission arm,
  OQ-316's owner ticket).
- DF-S1.20-1 members — the `steerable`/`plan_execute`/`workflow`/
  `program` `decide` interpreter legs, the out-of-process

## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. Durable steer transport: `queue_next_turn` writes a durable record
   that survives restart; `deliver_wakeup` gains the `steer` admission
   arm — one seam, owned here.
2. The `steerable`/`plan_execute` interpreter halves and the
   `workflow`/`program` legs — typed `Unsupported` where a mode cannot
   run hermetically, never a silent fallback.
3. The OOP conformance suite for the interpreter surface and the
   env-owned kill half.
4. DF-S2.11-1, DF-S1.20-1 discharged or reduced to dated residuals;
   DF-S2.8-1 records the steer leg.

## What landed

### Durable steer transport (DF-S2.11-1 → DONE)

`steer{mode: next_turn}` stages the input as
`context.artefact.delivered`, lazily mints one `manual{principal}`
wakeup subscription per run/principal (`delivery_mode = steer`,
`coalesce = none`, `max_pending = 16`, no expiry), and appends
`control.wakeup.occurred{occurrence_key: steer:<payload_ref>}`. The
existing `deliver_wakeup`/drain path fires it into the driver as
`Cue::Woken{delivery_mode: steer, payload_ref}` — one durable cue
channel, no second transport (ADR-0337 D1). `SessionState::pending_steer`
is deleted; the durable prefix is the cue's only home.

The OQ-316 admission arm (`hh-ledger/src/wakeup.rs`): `steer` is
admitted only on `trigger = manual{principal}` — every other trigger
form answers typed `WakeupPolicyUnsupported`; `manual + follow_up`
stays fleet-bound; `deliver_after` withholds fired steer deliveries
until committed effects settle; `deliver_due_wakeups` excludes `steer`
(the driver drain owns it — a surface poll never consumes a control
cue).

Restart leg proven on a real store reopen: `occurred` (pre-restart)
orders before `fired` (post lease-expiry takeover) carrying the staged
`payload_ref` — `hh-embed/tests/r2_6.rs::r2_6_queued_steer_survives_restart`.

### Declaration-driven steering; no silent substitute

`steering_for` reads the registered `VariantRecord`'s
`capability_declaration` (`steer_mode`/`concurrent_input`), falling back
to the impl's declared capability only when no record exists.
`hh/react-steerable-queue` is seeded as the `queue_next_turn` variant —
a registry alias binding the `ReactSteerable` impl with the declaration's
mode. `strategy_for`/`variant_for` return `Option`: an unregistered ref
is a typed refusal at `open`, replay (`unknown_control_variant` — the
dispersion loop now records an `invalid` verdict + closes the
`replay_started`/`replay_finished` pair instead of a silent `continue`),
and plugin `bind` (`NotInstalled`) — the fallback-to-`react/minimal`
defect class is dead on both sides of the process line (ADR-0337 D3).

### Staged interpreters + the canonical wire

`ReactSteerable::decide` interprets `Woken{steer}` as the same
`propose{steer_ref}` answer as `HumanInput::Steer`, and
`Woken{follow_up}` as `{follow_up_ref}` — under a declared steering
mode; forged/empty-payload cues fall through to the shared table.
`PlanExecute` answers `interrupt`/`cancel_requested` with
`stop{cancelled}` and parks unsequenced cues. `StagedVariant`
(`hh/workflow`, `hh/program`) parks every cue on `human_input` but
still answers the stop protocol — a parked run stays cancellable
(ADR-0256 D6 posture preserved; ADR-0337 D4).

`hh-control/src/wire.rs` is the canonical document codec:
`ControlContext`/events/`Cue`/`ControlDecision`/`FinalReport`/
`ControlError`/`RestoreError`/state-checkpoint — the one spelling on the
wire, in tests, and at the ABI edge (CC1). `ControlStrategy` carries
`Send` — the OOP host leg moves bound variants onto the protocol thread;
a pure-fold strategy has no thread-affinity claim.

### OOP conformance lane + env kill (DF-S1.20-1 members)

`hh-plugin-fixture --mode control` serves the contract's six ops over
`plugin_abi/1` `invoke` — canonical docs in/out, caller-carried state
(purity by construction), typed `schema_violation`/`unhandled_operation`/
`not_installed` refusals. `hh-varhost/tests/control_strategy.rs` drives
`hh/react-steerable-queue`/`hh/react-minimal`/`hh/react-steerable`
through the real `hh-helper` boundary: steer interpretation
(`woken{steer}` → `propose{steer_ref}`), the declaration boundary
(minimal never mints `steer_ref`), the stop protocol, decide
determinism, checkpoint/restore round-trip, typed refusals.

### Two latent defects the cells proved out

- **`Driver::resume_from` alloc watermark** (`hh-control/src/driver.rs`):
  the resumed driver initialised `next_id: 0` — the first post-takeover
  decision re-minted `d-1` over the committed `control.decision` row
  (`DuplicateEventId`). In-process takeovers masked it by carrying the
  live driver; the durable-resume path only surfaced under a restart
  that *drove* afterwards. `resume_from` now seeds `next_id`,
  `decision_events`, and `last_decision_ref` from the durable prefix —
  the same rule `open`/`replay_from` apply (ADR-0337 D7).
- **`LocalExecutor::drain_child` deadline starvation**
  (`hh-env/src/local.rs`): the drain loop read a *blocking* pipe — a
  silent child (the hanging-tool case the deadline exists for) starved
  the check and ran to natural exit; the env-owned kill was dead code.
  The drain now pumps one reader thread per pipe through a bounded
  `recv_timeout` poll — the deadline check runs every iteration, the
  kill SIGKILLs and reaps, `tool_error{timeout}` +
  `outcome_hint = "unknown"` report (ADR-0337 D6). The dispatcher-level
  cell settles `unknown{executor_error}` with the durable
  `action.effect.unknown` row (`hh-env/tests/r2_6.rs` 2/2) — env owns
  the kill, the ledger owns the truth, the driver records `unknown`.

## ADRs

- ADR-0337 — durable steer transport (wakeup-occurrence record form),
  the `manual{principal}` admission arm, declaration-driven steering +
  no-silent-substitute, the canonical wire + `Send` supertrait, the OOP

## Notes / caveats

- The restart test asserts the durable delivery (occurred→fired with
  the staged `payload_ref` across the reopen); the
  `propose{steer_ref}` answer is the sibling test's cell — a run may
  legitimately finish before the queued cue's own decision point
  (delivery is the fact the restart owes).
- `hh/react-steerable-queue` shares `ReactSteerable`'s impl and
  `variant_ref` (`hh/react-steerable@1`) — the alias is registry
  declaration data; a checkpoint restored under the sibling alias
  passes `variant_ref` validation (same impl, same state dialect).
- Pre-existing lint repairs in `hh-subagent` (untouched crate, base
  carried the debt under clippy 1.94): `for_kv_map`,
  `too_many_arguments`, `type_complexity`, `needless_option_as_deref`
  — mechanical, no semantic change.
- Size: see `git diff --stat` vs the 1,400-line budget — the mandated
  acceptance batteries dominate; noted honestly if over.
